mangala: I take refuge in the goddess Nīlā. You carry us safely across; salutations to you, the swift and mighty one.
m01: Om. Sing praise. Rich in ghee through your sovereign powers, O Savitṛ, and rich in milk, may the quarter be a delight to us. She is the steadfast one among the quarters: Viṣṇu's consort, gentle, ruling over this might, she who is the disposer. ॥1॥
m02: May Bṛhaspati, Mātariśvan and Vāyu, and the winds blowing together, greet us. The prop of heaven, the support of the earth, ruling over this world: she is Viṣṇu's consort. ॥2॥
gayatri: Om. May we know Mahādevī and meditate on Viṣṇu's consort; may that Nīlā impel us.
